schema: ProfitDecoded paid-API budget policy. Read by core/profitdecoded/budget.js before every paid call. Enabling paid calls is a reviewed change to this file (paidEnabled: true), never a runtime flag.
notes: targetPerScriptUsd is an optimisation goal; maxPerScriptUsd is enforced before each call against the maximum possible cost.
A script is topicId:format:version (PD_SCRIPT_VERSION, default v1). All attempts and resumed runs of that script share the per-script limit.
Pools: script (production) and experiment. A run declares its pool; each pool has its own monthly limit (UTC calendar month).
Application limits do not cap provider billing. Set a monthly spend limit in the Anthropic Console as the backstop.

paidApproval is required as well as paidEnabled: {"id": "<unique id>", "scriptId": "<topicId>:<format>:<version>", "pool": "experiment", "expiresAt": "<ISO time>", "approvedBy": "<person>"}, optionally with "model" (the only Claude model id it covers) and "maxUsd" (its own spend cap, below the per-script limit). It is single-use: the workflow closes it in the ledger as soon as the paid production step ends (success, failure, pause or cancellation); a new run needs a new id. expiresAt is the backstop if a runner dies before the close step.
The Anthropic key for ProfitDecoded is the repository secret PD_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (never ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which other channels' workflows read).
